scope: one straight undamped clamped-clamped beam; no joint

bachoo.table2_role: future source-frame benchmark only; NOT_RUN in NSL-1

base_material.name: RLB-2E weakly orthotropic M0; all H/L elastic moduli scaled

spectral_case.units: consistent normalized units inherited from RLB-2E; omega is angular frequency

policy.upper_rationale: Seven pure-w sine trial functions with u=psi=0 imply omega7<=7*pi*sqrt(S/m)/L<14.
policy.count_proof: Exact segment Dirichlet-to-Neumann assembly; coercivity lower bound excludes all segment poles below the preset ceiling. Count is negative inertia on interior traces.
policy.failure_policy: Save diagnostics and PARTIAL_PASS/FAIL. No automatic range, order, tolerance or geometry changes.
policy.precedent: RLB-0A independent Ritz: frequency/convergence 1e-8, boundary 1e-9; RLB-1C-ISO energy 1e-8, shapes 1e-6. Larger fixed orders address seven modes rather than only a fundamental.
